illustrations.prompt: Two adult Kassena neighbours greeting each other warmly at dusk in front of a mud-walled compound decorated with Kassena geometric wall paintings. A woman in a patterned wrapper and head wrap and a man in a woven batakari smock and cap, both smiling, each with one hand raised in greeting. Place both people in the right half of the picture. Keep the left half calm: soft dark forest-green shadow and a hint of savanna, with no people or detail, so text can sit over it. A low golden sun near the top right.
illustrations.composedPrompt:
House style for the Indigen World Kasem course:
- A warm, painterly storybook illustration with flat shapes, soft brush texture and gentle grain. Not photographic, not 3D.
- Palette: deep forest green, muted mint, warm gold, terracotta and ochre earth, with cream highlights. Soft dusk or morning light and low-contrast shadows.
- Setting: the Kassena homeland in the Upper East Region of Ghana and southern Burkina Faso. Sahel savanna, baobab and shea trees, laterite earth, mud-walled compounds, some walls painted with Kassena geometric patterns (triangles, chevrons, lozenges and bands in red ochre, black and white).
- People are ordinary Kassena people of any age, shown with dignity and warmth, never as caricature. Everyday clothes: woven smocks (batakari), shirts, patterned wrappers and head wraps.
- Do not show masks, shrines, sacrifices, funerals or ritual objects, real identifiable people, or any written text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.

illustrations.prompt: A Kassena family together outside their painted compound in warm late-afternoon light: a father in a woven batakari smock, a mother in a patterned wrapper and head wrap, a grandmother seated on a low wooden stool, and two young children laughing, one holding a small calabash. A baobab tree behind them. Everyone relaxed and happy.
